- PDF 1.4 introduced RC4-128 (Source 1 [doc8_p16_c2] and Source 5 [doc8_p16_c0] mention PDF 1.4 but only Source 1 mentions RC4-128).

- PDF 2.0 mandates AES-256 as the standard encryption algorithm, providing strong protection (Source 1 [doc8_p16_c2] and Source 4 [doc8_p16_c1]).
